DH11 Network Graphs

Elijah Meeks

Originally published at Digital Humanities Specialist. This edition preserves the original text and historical context.

Just a quick note for anyone that wants to critique, analyze or browse the networks I used to create the DH2011 Network Visualization page.  I put the original .gephi project file along with csv, gdf, gexf and graphml versions of the DH11 network  of participants in this zip file.  If you haven’t yet had the chance to play with Gephi or Network Workbench, then this may give you a good place to start.
